gemini-3-pro.notes: Preview pricing. ≤200K tokens: $2/$12 per million. >200K tokens: $4/$18 per million. 1M token context window.

gemini-3-flash.notes: Preview pricing. Context caching available (90% savings). 50% discount with batch API.

gemini-2.5-pro.notes: Standard pricing for prompts ≤200K tokens. >200K tokens: $2.50 input, $15 output. 50% discount with batch API.

gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Paid tier pricing. Audio input: $1.00/million. 50% discount with batch API.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite.notes: Most cost-efficient model in 2.5 family. Stable and generally available.

gemini-1.5-pro.notes: Legacy model. Consider upgrading to Gemini 2.5 Pro or 3 Pro.

gemini-1.5-flash.notes: Legacy model. Consider upgrading to Gemini 2.5 Flash or 3 Flash.
